title: Jamaican Fritter Bites
description: Crispy Jamaican fritter bites are a delicious vegetarian snack inspired by the island flavors of Jamaica.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, jamaican spice mix, and a pinch of salt.
2. Add the cold milk and cold water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
3. Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
4. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the fritter batter into the hot oil.
5. Fry the fritters for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Sprinkle the shredded coconut on top of the fritters before serving.
